name: antigravity
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Antigravity instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Antigravity tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Antigravity through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Antigravity Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Antigravity only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
